latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Markdown Editor skill (v1.0.0).
- Instantly converts markdown documents (with headers and bullet points) into 1080p formatted video slides.
- Simple workflow: upload your markdown or script and describe your desired video; receive a downloadable video in 1–2 minutes.
- Automates setup with session and token management (including free anonymous access).
- Supports key commands for export, credits, status, upload, and general editing—mapped by user prompt.
- All video rendering happens in the cloud—no installation or local GPU required.
